save_did_keyfile_subtitle: Download your cryptographic keypair (.json) in one click to sign in or recover your DID on any device.
decentralized_nickname_hint: Doesn't need to be unique — your identity is a cryptographic keypair (DID), not a central server account.
login_nickname_alias_sub: Used with your password for quick sign-in — need not be unique (#tag distinguishes same names)
did_tag_tooltip: 4-character fingerprint derived from your public cryptographic key
did_keyfile_backup_desc: Export your cryptographic DID keypair as a portable .json file in one click. You can use this file to sign in instantly on any browser or device without entering a password.
invalid_keyfile_json: Invalid keyfile: could not parse JSON.
invalid_keyfile_missing_pub: Keyfile does not contain a valid DID keypair.
